# Wiki Audit

Audit is read-only. Check broken links, missing paths, stale commands, source
contradictions, duplicates, generic advice, oversized/low-value pages,
root/workspace overlap, and pages not routed by the index. Report findings and
direct corrections through `wiki reinit`; never edit during audit.
